<title level="1" right="Hazard 9" pfs="">[Repelling Surge](/Hazards.aspx?ID=409)</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #195: Heavy is the Crown](/Sources.aspx?ID=210) pg. 31

**Complexity** Simple

</column>

A shockwave of energy surges out from the room's center.

---

**Stealth**
DC 30 (master)

**Disable**
DC 29 [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) (expert) to fool the wards, DC 31 [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) (master) to disable the wards, or [_dispel magic_](/Spells.aspx?ID=78) (5th level; [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) DC 28) to counteract the wards

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Repel** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [evocation](/Traits.aspx?ID=65), [force](/Traits.aspx?ID=75)) **Trigger** A creature that isn't a Rivethun practitioner enters the room; **Effect** The trap deals 5d4+12 force damage to the triggering creature (DC 32 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save). On a failed save, they're additionally [knocked back](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 10 feet.

---
**Reset**
automatic
